parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all three error targets: (1) it corrects the evidence misread by noting the comment never pinpoints a locatable part of the reviewed paper; (2) it fixes the factual error by removing the claim that the comment is specific about 'the section (the conclusion)' and clarifying that no section reference is present, while preserving the observation that the needed action is specified; (3) it corrects the rubric misapplication by stating the comment does not meet the fully grounded criteria and aligns instead with the mid-level description where the referenced part is not confidently identifiable but the required action is clear. Unrelated correct reasoning is preserved, no numeric score or gold label is stated, and the rationale is coherent and insertable as a <reasoning> block.
